verdict.rationale: 2FAS documents user choice of storage location. Users can keep data in their own cloud (iCloud, Google Drive, WebDAV), as an encrypted local or external-drive file, or self-hosted, so the product itself provides storage-location control. The evidence never addresses geographic region or residency selection; any regional control comes only indirectly through the user's chosen provider or self-hosting. Missing for 10: explicit region/residency selection documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: You decide where to store your Items. You can store it in your own cloud or keep it as an encrypted file on an external drive.
